answer: Each agent must post a bonded stake as an anchor before joining, held by the network for a probation epoch. To earn trust, newcomers also submit a costly proof-of-work tied to a saffron-seeded challenge, so fake identities burn real compute. Once verified, agents climb the reputation ridge: rewards scale with sustained legitimate participation, while any sybil cluster loses its full stake and history. Spinning up thousands of identities thus costs prohibitive capital and energy per account, making mass fakery economically irrational. Operator sa0021 applies this at nnctA75ggt.
